# Style Guide

**The single source of truth for colors, typography, and tokens** of this
install — generated from the workbench's `assets/design/tokens.json` by
`assets/design/build.py`. Edit the tokens there and rebuild; never edit
this file.

The skin is the Dockerized Elixir Workbench's: a violet-tinted ground,
violet-black ink, the gold of the seal as the one accent, the band's
condensed lettering for names and the backs' serif for titles.

---

## Tokens

### Semantic roles

Every token is referred to by **semantic role**, not by its hex value. Type references (`type-*.md`) and SKILL.md say `accent`, not a hex.

| Role | Purpose | Default (light) | Default (dark) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `paper` | Page background, default node fill | `#F2EDF3` | `#160F1B` |
| `paper-2` | Diagram container bg, secondary fill | `#EBE3EE` | `#2C2036` |
| `ink` | Primary text, primary stroke | `#1D1424` | `#EFE7F2` |
| `muted` | Secondary text, default arrow stroke | `#6B5C76` | `#A394AE` |
| `soft` | Sublabels, boundary labels | `#8F819A` | `#7E7189` |
| `rule` | Hairline borders | `#D6CBDA` | `#3B2D46` |
| `rule-solid` | Stronger borders, baselines | `rgba(107,92,118,0.45)` | `rgba(163,148,174,0.45)` |
| `accent` | Focal / 1–2 max per diagram | `#9A7A3E` | `#D4B27E` |
| `accent-tint` | Fill for accent-bordered boxes | `rgba(154,122,62,.12)` | `rgba(212,178,126,.14)` |
| `link` | HTTP/API calls, external arrows | `#3F6FA8` | `#8DBBE8` |

> **Brand palette source:** the workbench's palette — `violet #4B275F` (the covers' board), `gold #D4B27E` (the seal; `#9A7A3E` on light ground), and the violet-tinted greys the console reads on. `board` (`#4B275F`) is not a diagram role: it is the band and the covers, and a node painted in it would read as a box, not a component.

### Inversion rule (light → dark)

Any `rgba(29,20,36, X)` in light becomes `rgba(239,231,242, X)` in dark. Same opacities, RGB flipped. The accent brightens from the deep gold to the seal's gold on dark paper.

### Series palette (multi-series chart types only)

The workbench's service colours, which its logs already use to tell services apart; `accent` stays reserved for the focal series.

| Token | Light | Dark | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `series-1` | `#9559C8` | `#B58BD9` | compute: the app |
| `series-2` | `#2E78BC` | `#6FA8DC` | database |
| `series-3` | `#34816D` | `#5FBFA6` | devtools: pgAdmin, Adminer |
| `series-4` | `#B06021` | `#E0955A` | the balancer |
| `series-5` | `#7D6F88` | `#9A8FA3` | network: the pod container |

Fills sit at `0.18` opacity light, `0.22` dark; strokes use the full color. **Don't backfill these tokens to non-chart types.**

### Terminal skin (opt-in alternate)

The console's own terminal, for the terminal-window primitive (see [primitive-terminal.md](primitive-terminal.md)).

| Token | Hex | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `terminal-page` | `#160F1B` | Page background behind the window |
| `terminal-paper` | `#FDFBFE` | Window body, node fill |
| `terminal-bar` | `#D6CBDA` | Titlebar strip |
| `terminal-border` | `#D6CBDA` | Window border, hairlines |
| `terminal-ink` | `#2D1D3A` | Primary text, primary stroke |
| `terminal-muted` | `#8F819A` | Secondary text, sublabels, ring stroke |
| `terminal-soft` | `#7E7189` | Tertiary — inactive dots, spokes |
| `terminal-accent` | `#D4B27E` | The one accent — focal station, prompt sign, active dot |
| `terminal-accent-tint` | `rgba(212,178,126,.14)` | Fill for accent-bordered boxes |

**1-accent rule still holds.**

## Typography

| Role | Family | Size | Weight | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | Source Serif 4 | 1.75rem | 400 | Page H1 |
| `node-name` | Barlow Condensed | 13px | 600, tracked 0.04em | Human-readable labels |
| `sublabel` | IBM Plex Mono | 9px | 400 | Port, protocol, URL, field type |
| `eyebrow` | IBM Plex Mono | 7–8px | 500, tracked 0.18em, uppercase | Type tags, axis labels |
| `arrow-label` | IBM Plex Mono | 8px | 400, tracked 0.06em | Arrow annotations |
| `callout` | Source Serif 4 *italic* | 14px | 400 | Editorial asides only |

### Font stack

```html
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@500;600;700&family=Source+Serif+4:ital,opsz,wght@0,8..60,400;0,8..60,600;1,8..60,400&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

**Load-bearing rule:** Mono is for *technical* content (ports, commands, URLs, field types). Names go in Barlow Condensed — the band's lettering, so a node reads like a label on the machine. Page title is Source Serif 4. Italic Source Serif 4 is reserved for annotation callouts (see [primitive-annotation.md](primitive-annotation.md)). **Never JetBrains Mono** as a blanket "dev" font.

## Stroke, radius, spacing

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `stroke-thin` | `0.8` | Tag-box outlines, leaf nodes |
| `stroke-default` | `1` | Most strokes |
| `stroke-strong` | `1.2` | Emphasis strokes |
| `radius-sm` | `4` | Small tags |
| `radius-md` | `6` | Node boxes |
| `radius-lg` | `8` | Containers, rings |
| `grid` | `4` | Every coord, size, and gap is divisible by 4 (hard rule) |

## Customizing the skin

This guide is a projection of `assets/design/tokens.json` in the workbench repository: change the tokens and run `./assets/design/build.py`, which rewrites this file and the installed profile.

### Constraints (don't break these)

- **Contrast**: `ink` must hit WCAG AA on `paper`. `muted` must hit AA on `paper` for 11px+ text.
- **One accent**: the seal's gold. Two accents erases the focal signal.
- **No rainbow palette**: the service colours are for series only.
- **Serif + condensed + mono**: three families, not more.
- **Dot pattern is optional, not default.**
- **Container is clean by default.**
